summary: Runway 08R/26L closed at London Gatwick Airport, with runway 08L/26R in use between 2200 and 0600.
text:
RWY 08R/26L CLSD. RWY 08L/26R IN USE 2200-0600. LIGHTS FOR CLSD.
RWY 08R/26L AND PARALLEL TWY NOT VISIBLE ON APCH. FROM 2200-2210
AND 0550-0600 NEITHER RWY 08R/26L OR 08L/26R WILL BE AVBL TO ALLOW
